role_separation.warning: Map/proof/RRC text is not source evidence unless the claim is about the map/proof/RRC itself.

similar_section_delta_map.note: Deep near-duplicate shingle clustering is reserved for --delta-map; this RRC records sensitive-token classes for delta review.

gap_map.unsupported_external_content_rule: External URLs are not source-verified unless fweb captured and hashed them.

document_faq_challenge_questions.question: What is the document's main operational purpose?
document_faq_challenge_questions.expected_boundary: Answer from source zones, not from title alone.

document_faq_challenge_questions.question: Which role blocks or source/map/proof distinctions matter?
document_faq_challenge_questions.expected_boundary: Do not treat map/proof text as source evidence.

document_faq_challenge_questions.question: Which high-signal domains were detected (ai, code, record, legal, sensitive)?
document_faq_challenge_questions.expected_boundary: Report signals as routing aids, not proof.

document_faq_challenge_questions.question: What should remain UNKNOWN without more source material or external verification?
document_faq_challenge_questions.expected_boundary: External URLs and missing files stay unresolved unless verified.

document_faq_challenge_questions.question: Are there sensitive deltas, repeated sections, or near-duplicate risks?
document_faq_challenge_questions.expected_boundary: Do not collapse similar-looking sections without checking changed facts.

document_faq_challenge_questions.question: Negative control: does the document support an unrelated topic such as bbq grills or summertime recreation?
document_faq_challenge_questions.expected_boundary: Expected answer: not supported unless a source zone actually contains it.

ai_read_receipt_instruction: State what source material was available.
State what map/proof/RRC material was available.
State which source zones were used.
Disclose gaps and external URLs that were not verified.
Distinguish source-supported claims from map-supported routing claims.
Answer the document challenge questions before final claims when asked.

rrc_status.reason: Source text recovered and receipt generated.

external_reference_rule: Generated RRC is source-local by default. External references require fweb capture + hash before reliance.
